description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession class, specifically testing the decrypt buffer functionality in a media key session context, including success, failure, and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionDecryptBufferTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for decrypt buffer tests in media key sessions, inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test that the buffer decryption succeeds when the underlying decryptBuffer call returns OK.

methods.name: OcdmSessionFailure
methods.description: Test that the decrypt method returns failure when the underlying decryptBuffer call fails.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Test that the decrypt method returns failure if an error is triggered during decryption via onError.
